c74object.name: evi.vosim.basic~
c74object.digest: A basic implementation of a 'vosim' formant oscillator
c74object.description:
evi.vosim.basic~ is a 'max define' for the evi_vosim_basic.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.vosim.basic~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
This is a 'raw' formant oscillator with low level controls capable of modelling the human voice, typically used in a bank of multiple oscillators to do so. However, a single evi.vosim.basic~ instance can provide a novel oscillator for more generic synthesis, and is capable of ringing filtered-like tones. The VOSIM algorithm is inherently bandlimited.

inlet.digest: Inlet #1: T: Pulse Width in ms
inlet.description: The width of a single pulse that makes up a formant. A typical use case is to control this parameter simultaneously with 'M' (inlet 2), for example on an XY pad.
The delay at the end of a series of pulses, before the next formant is triggered. A typical use case is to control this parameter simultaneously with 'T' (inlet 1), for example on an XY pad.
The number of pulses used to create a single formant.
The amplitude of the first pulse of the formant. A typical use case is to control this parameter simultaneously with '∂A' (inlet 5), for example on an XY pad.
The decay window over which the series of pulses envelope the formant. A typical use case is to control this parameter simultaneously with 'A' (inlet 4), for example on an XY pad.

outlet.description: The frequency is a result of the lower level input parameters and is outlet here for further processing downstream.

c74object.discussion: This originally comes from a forum thread with contributions by Gregory Taylor, jvkr and Oli Larkin. This has since been put into the gen~ examples folder as 'gen~.vosim'. See evi.paf~ for an alternative.
